snippet.title: I Won't Let You Level Up In My Goblin Town Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo out now. Wishlist please.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3019490/I_Wont_Let_You_Level_Up_In_My_Goblin_Town/

Interfere in a turn based fight! When adventurers come to your goblin town to level up, your strongest warrior goblin meets them in Active Time Battle. Run around town gathering the equipment and potions he needs to defeat any adventurer party.
